rules: CRITICAL: Read ALL sections of AGENTS.md before making any edit or taking any action
Run git diff --cached and git diff after changes, then propose a commit message — never commit automatically
Update CHANGELOG.md + src/data/changelog.js + version in index.html + public/version.json with every significant change
Add new UI strings to both es/en in src/utils/i18n.js
All rendering goes through render() — never draw to tile canvases outside this function
Respect SOLID principles: SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, DIP
Evaluate subagent usage before responding — see Subagent Consideration in AGENTS.md
Update README if documented features or setup change
